name: Kenbuchi (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Kenbuchi town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kenbuchi, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 20 June 1968.

features.role: Kenbuchi town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a stylised character of angular strokes
